summary: Arcadia Biosciences filed an 8-K item 5.02(f) to disclose a discretionary cash bonus of $169,000 awarded to CEO/Interim CFO Thomas J. Schaefer for 2025, along with an updated Summary Compensation Table. No other named executive officer received a bonus. The filing is purely compensatory in nature, updating previously reported executive compensation details as required by SEC rules. It does not involve any M&A, capital return, restructuring, special committee evaluation, tender, or activist event. The filing is a routine current report on compensation arrangements, not a special situation.
